title: One week to make $2,000 back, and Mom ends up on his team
description: Mom catches Nate spending his $2,000 on coins with three dollars made and gives him one week to win it all back; after all-nighters and a moment of doubt the wins pour in on fomo, Mom takes a phone and trades beside him, and they share a six-figure balance. The reselling becomes trading on fomo, the live-action tag becomes Nate's fomo line. Unlike the other two, the night grind comes first, then Mom softens in the doorway ('You don't have to prove anything to me'), and it ends warm on 'We did' with no comic button.
text:
SCENE 1 — INT. NATE'S BEDROOM — DAY
The bedroom door bursts open; Mom storms in brandishing Nate's wallet.
MOM: Nate! Where is all your money?
Over Mom's shoulder: Nate spins round in his gaming chair at his desk.
NATE: What?
Fast push in as Mom slams the wallet on the table.
MOM: You had $2,000!
Nate flails in the chair, arms flung out.
NATE: I spent it!
MOM: On what?
NATE: My business!
Two whip-pans across his set-up: the phone on a stand, the old laptop, chart sketches taped up the wall.
MOM: You spent $2,000 on coins?
Nate thrusts his phone up at her, indignant.
NATE: They're not just coins!
MOM: How much have you made?
Nate checks his phone.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the position reads +$3.00
NATE: Actually, I just started.
Snap zoom into Mom's face: bulging eyes, gritted teeth.
MOM: Three?
NATE: Yes!
Mom throws both hands up, slams the wallet down and jabs a finger in his face.
MOM: You spent $2,000!
NATE: I'm gonna make it back!
MOM: Then prove it!
NATE: How?
MOM: One week!
NATE: For what?
MOM: Make your $2,000 back.
NATE: All of it?
Tight profile two-shot, nose to nose, slow push in.
MOM: Every dollar!
NATE: Fine.
SCENE 2 — MONTAGE — NATE'S BEDROOM — NIGHT
Locked-off on Nate at his desk, the wall clock behind him at 11:48: he sets up chart alerts on his phone.
Nate hunched over the old laptop, his face lit by the screen, scribbling notes.
Nate stretches his arms up, yawns, checks his phone again.
★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on Nate's phone, the line flat and red, the position still at +$3.00
Stutter jump cuts as the light flips warm, then moonlit blue: Nate tapping, refreshing, rubbing his eyes, the clock hands racing to 2:14.
SCENE 3 — INT. NATE'S BEDROOM — NIGHT
Nate at the laptop in the dark room, drained; the lit doorway behind him.
NATE: I spent everything.
Mom appears in the doorway and leans on the frame, gentle.
MOM: You don't have to prove anything to me.
NATE: Yes, I do.
NATE: I said I could do this.
Something on his phone makes Nate lean in.
NATE: Wait.
NATE: Wait.
NATE: Wait.
Crash zoom into his eye.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $3,300
NATE: Three! Three!
Cut to black for a beat. Then Nate's face in the phone glow as the green chart keeps climbing.
NATE: No way!
He leaps up and bolts out of the room.
NATE: Mom!
Into the hallway, two-shot with Mom.
MOM: What?
NATE: Look!
MOM: What am I looking at?
NATE: Wins!
MOM: How many?
NATE: Ten.
SCENE 4 — INT. NATE'S BEDROOM — DAY
Wide on Nate at his desk in daylight, time-lapse: phone stands and a ring light multiply around him as he counts.
NATE: Twenty.
NATE: Thirty.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $14,800
At the kitchen table, sped up: Nate taps two phones at once while Mom watches.
MOM: Wait!
NATE: They're still coming!
MOM: Right now?
Mom snatches a phone out of his hand and taps away herself.
MOM: Give me that.
NATE: What?
MOM: You're too slow.
Medium close-up on Nate: offended, then delighted.
NATE: Wait!
NATE: Okay!
SCENE 5 — MONTAGE — THE KITCHEN TABLE — DAYS AND NIGHTS
The same symmetrical two-shot of Nate and Mom side by side, each on a phone, as match cuts swap the world behind them: warm kitchen by day, sunny yard with palms, blue night, warm brick wall.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Mom's phone, the balance reads $29,700
Outside by the palms, Mom gives Nate a kiss on the cheek; at night, a quick hug, both grinning at camera.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $56,400
MOM: More!
MOM: Keep trading!
NATE: I am!
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $91,200
SCENE 6 — INT. LIVING ROOM — DAY
Nate and Mom stand side by side, staring at the phone in his hand.
★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $386,900
NATE: We did it.
MOM: You did.
NATE: No.
NATE: We did.
Mom pulls him into a hug; slow push in as Nate turns to camera, phone up, with a warm smile.
★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $386,900
NATE: Want to trade like me? Download fomo through the link in my bio.

cast.description: Teen, slim, big glossy brown eyes, thick dark brows, curly black hair; backwards navy cap, plain oversized white tee, thin silver chain, dark joggers, white sneakers.
Mid-40s, warm light-brown skin, brown chin-length bob, big expressive brows; beige silk blouse, dark navy trousers. Plays big comic fury at first, then soft and warm.
